description: Starts an AI video generation on the signed-in aicut account, puts the aicut card in front of the user and returns the new job's id immediately. It does NOT wait for the video. WHEN: the user asks for a video. Call `list_models` first if you have not this session (an unpublished combination is rejected). `get_recipe` `starter-video` has the first-video steps. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. `seedance-2.5` and `seedance-2.0-mini` often refuse a real person's image: say so BEFORE the ask, quote that it may be refused, and offer a generated character or another model. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: a video takes 1-3 minutes, up to about 6: do not assume it failed before then. COST: this spends the user's tokens. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's published `aspect_ratios` (for example `9:16`).

audio.description: Sound on the video, on the models that support it (`list_models` says whether it costs extra). DEFAULTS TO FALSE: a model sold on native audio still renders SILENT unless you set it: set it when the user asked for sound, dialogue or effects. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

character_ids.description: Ids of this account's UPLOADED characters (`kind: "uploaded"` in `list_characters`, up to 20, in order of appearance). aicut first draws a start frame placing them (a flat 0.2 tokens, included in `estimate_only`), so no `scenes`, `reference_images` or `reference_videos` with it. A `cast_member` id belongs to `generate_story_video`.

duration.description: Seconds, one of the model's published durations; longer costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

end_image.description: Image URL the video should end on. Same rules as `start_image`.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (for example `kling-3.0`). Use the one the user asked for; never substitute a cheaper model to save them tokens.

prompt.description: What the video should show. The model's `prompt` parameter in `list_models` gives its character limit.

reference_images.description: Image URLs for style or subject references, on the models that accept them. Same rules as `start_image`.

reference_videos.description: Reference video URLs, on the models that accept them: this account's own media or a public video (imported). Another account's is refused.

resolution.description: One of the model's published options (for example `1080p`); higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

scenes.description: A storyboard instead of one prompt: several scenes, each with its own prompt and duration; the provider returns ONE video. ONLY ON THE MODELS THAT PUBLISH IT (today `kling-3.0`): at most 5 scenes, each 1-15s, totaling 3-15s; another model or other bounds are refused. Omit `prompt`/`duration`/`start_image`/`end_image`/`reference_images` with it; `model` and whatever else the model requires (`resolution`, `aspect_ratio`) stay REQUIRED. Priced as one generation of the combined duration: use `estimate_only` first.

duration.description: This scene's own length in seconds.

prompt.description: This scene's own prompt: what happens in this shot.

start_image.description: Image URL to start the video from: a public https URL (aicut fetches and stores it) or an earlier generation's URL on this account.

name: generate_video
title: Generate an AI video
